# Support

Owlet Cam is an unofficial public preview maintained by volunteers.

- Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ohlsont/ha-owlet-cam/discussions/categories/q-a)
  for setup questions and troubleshooting that has not yet been reduced to a
  reproducible defect.
- Use the structured [bug report](https://github.com/ohlsont/ha-owlet-cam/issues/new/choose)
  for repeatable integration problems.
- Use the [beta report](https://github.com/ohlsont/ha-owlet-cam/issues/new/choose)
  to contribute installation or camera-compatibility evidence.
- Report vulnerabilities through
  [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ohlsont/ha-owlet-cam/security/advisories/new),
  never through a public issue.

Do not share an APK/APKM/XAPK, `.owletcam` package, native library, SDK key,
password, token, UID, AuthKey, AV password, camera identifier, unredacted local
path, private camera image, or video. Inspect downloaded diagnostics before
attaching them even though automated redaction tests are present.

No telemetry or remote support access is built into the integration. Maintainers
can act only on information a user deliberately and safely shares.
